verdict.rationale: Termius is a cloud-synced SSH client with team vaults, so offering scoped API tokens for agents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has no API, token, or scoped-credential feature, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. SSH key generation and vault sharing are credentials for reaching servers, not least-privilege API credentials for an agent, so they are not credited here.
